issue: Non-AA carrier rows in the raw BTS files (scope filter applied in the base step, before cleaning)
treatment: Excluded by design (Reporting_Airline = 'AA'); percent is of all raw rows
reason: Project scope is AA mainline; counts per month are in docs/d2/tables/aa_share_by_month.csv

issue: Cancelled flights: departure, arrival, delay, taxi and elapsed columns are null by definition
treatment: Kept as null (not imputed); flagged struct_null_cancelled
reason: Null means the flight did not operate, not that a value is missing

issue: Diverted flights: arrival-side columns are null by definition
treatment: Kept as null (not imputed); flagged struct_null_diverted
reason: BTS does not report arrival fields for diverted flights

issue: Delay-cause columns null because the flight is not a late arrival (ArrDelay < 15) or did not operate
treatment: Kept as null (not imputed); flagged struct_null_delay_cause
reason: BTS fills the five cause columns only for arrivals 15+ minutes late; zero would be a false value

issue: CancellationCode null on flights that were not cancelled

treatment: Row kept; flagged dq_missing_tail; cannot join a rotation
reason: 11 of 11 are cancelled flights; they count as 'cancelled' in rotations.parquet

issue: Extreme delay: DepDelay or ArrDelay more than 24 hours
treatment: Row kept and original delays untouched; flagged dq_extreme_delay_24h; arr_delay_min_capped added for modelling
reason: Real events (flights held overnight); deleting them would bias delay statistics downwards

issue: ArrDelay outside the winsorising limits [-42.0, 454.0] min (train-period operated flights, quantiles 0.005 / 0.995)
treatment: Clipped in the new column arr_delay_min_capped; original ArrDelay unchanged
reason: Limits come from train data only, so no test information enters the cap; for models sensitive to extreme values

issue: Duplicate flight key (FlightDate, flight number, Origin, Dest, CRSDepTime)
Time conflict: UTC block time differs from BTS CRSElapsedTime by 0.5 min or more
reason: Mismatching flights are on the US daylight-saving change date (see docs/d2/tables/time_conflicts.csv); the BTS value looks like it ignores the clock change. Not verified with BTS

issue: Time conflict: AirTime greater than ActualElapsedTime
Time conflict: ArrDel15 inconsistent with ArrDelay

reason: Operated flights should always have an arrival delay

issue: Taxi time over 180 minutes (TaxiOut or TaxiIn)
reason: Plausibly real (long ground holds); not removed

issue: ActualElapsedTime differs from CRSElapsedTime by more than 180 minutes
reason: Holding, diversion-like routing or extreme taxi; not removed

issue: Distance zero, negative or above 5000 miles
Nulls not explained by the structural rules (unexpected missing values), excluding Tail_Number which is counted above
reason: Every null in an operated flight's timing columns would be unexpected; see docs/d2/tables/missing_by_column.csv
